title: Casas-Alvero Conjecture
exact_target: If a polynomial shares a root with each of its nonconstant-order derivatives, must all its roots coincide? Different derivatives may share different roots a priori.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1107 (ALG-007). CC BY 4.0.
Soham Ghosh, \emph{A finiteness result towards the Casas--Alvero Conjecture}, arXiv:2402.18717, revised version, Section 1, Conjecture CA.
